title: Refund policy
text: Refunds apply only to paid invoices. Refunds above 5000 MXN need approval from a finance supervisor who is not the requester.

title: Credit terms
text: Gold and platinum customers may pay at 30 days. Standard customers pay when the invoice is issued.

title: Replenishment
text: Reorder when stock falls below 10 units. The target level is 20 units.

title: Finance escalations
text: Escalations above 50000 MXN go to the CFO office. Bank reconciliation runs every Friday.
